get_config_ch4: get the FermiNet configuration for running a methane CH4 molecule simulation with 5 alpha and 5 beta electrons
review_get_config: review the get_config function that returns a ConfigDict for methane geometry in bohr units
summarize_ch4_config: summarize the methane molecule configuration including carbon and hydrogen atom coordinates and electron counts
refactor_get_config: refactor the get_config function to support a different molecule geometry or electron count
test_get_config: test the get_config function to verify it returns a valid ConfigDict with correct CH4 molecule data
